opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st day of February, April, June, August, October and December (bi-monthly)

amount.raw: Scheme A up to £200; Scheme B up to £500 (Adelphi co-sponsored up to £750); Scheme C up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society 'junior scientist' members. Scheme A open to undergraduate, Master's and PhD student members and postdocs within 6 years of PhD viva. Schemes B & C open to PhD student and postdoc members within 6 years of PhD viva. Must present a poster or give a talk at the conference. UK-based members for non-UK conferences; non-UK members for UK conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at genetics research conferences: (A) Genetics Society/SIG meetings (travel & accommodation), (B) non-Genetics Society meetings (travel, accommodation, registration), and (C) virtual conferences (registration costs).

opportunities.title: Training Grant

deadlines.raw: Quarterly at midnight on 15th February, May, August and November

opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or where the course is held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others must be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Enables members to attend formal short training courses in genetics or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques. Covers travel, accommodation, subsistence and registration/tuition fees.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant

deadlines.raw: Quarterly at midnight on 1st February, May, August, November

opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others must be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Covers travel and accommodation costs associated with a field-based genetic research project whose results would typically be suitable for publication in the Society's journal Heredity. Funded by income from Heredity.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member can apply, regardless of age of the person they are caring for. Priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Provides a daily allowance to support members with caring responsibilities to attend Genetics Society meetings and events, spent as the recipient thinks best supports their attendance. Claimable in arrears on production of receipts.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Sponsorship

amount.raw: Sponsor a specific lecture for a few hundred pounds; a session up to about £1,000; as major sponsor several thousand pounds (major sponsorship levels last 12 months between £1,000 and £2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society members. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK. Grants are for organising meetings, not attending.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, including one-off meetings with ad hoc organising committees. Applications may be made at any time of year, at least three months in advance of the event.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant

deadlines.raw: Two deadlines per year (1st March and 1st October)

opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually. Funding may cover eligible travel and materials costs (UK-based, budget/economy travel only).

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society members. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK. Applications to become a new SIG should be submitted at least three months before the first meeting.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes, supporting genetics research communities who wish to run regular series of meetings. Covers speaker travel, accommodation, publicity and other direct meeting costs.
